question: Do I need to book in advance?
answer: We recommend booking online to secure your seat, especially on Saturdays and during busy periods. Choose a date and session from our online booking calendar.

question: How much does pottery painting cost?
answer: There is no additional studio fee. A £12 booking payment per person secures your seat and is deducted from the pottery you choose on the day. Pottery starts from £12.

question: How long is a pottery painting session?
answer: Our regular Pick & Paint sessions last two hours.

question: Can I visit without booking?
answer: Please book a seat for painting, as sessions may be full. You do not need a painting seat simply to collect finished pottery or arrange a drop-off.

question: When are you open?
answer: Every Saturday, 10am–5pm, plus additional sessions on selected weekdays, Sundays and evenings. Our online booking calendar shows the latest available dates and times.

question: Does everyone need to book a seat?
answer: Yes. Everyone attending a seated pottery painting session needs a booked seat, including accompanying adults. The £12 booking payment is deducted from pottery purchased.

question: Do I need any experience?
answer: Not at all! Whether you’re trying pottery painting for the first time or have painted before, you’re very welcome. We’ll explain the process and happily share painting tips.

question: What can I paint?
answer: Choose from a changing selection of ready-to-paint pottery, such as mugs, bowls, plates, ornaments and seasonal pieces. Availability varies.

question: Can children paint pottery?
answer: Absolutely. Pottery painting is suitable for all ages, although younger children may need help from an accompanying adult.

question: Can I take my painted pottery home on the day?
answer: Painted pottery needs to be glazed and kiln-fired after your visit, so it will normally be ready for collection two weeks after your session.

question: Is finished pottery dishwasher safe?
answer: No. Please handwash your finished pottery gently; we do not recommend putting it in the dishwasher.

question: What if I’m not artistic?
answer: You don’t need to be! Simple colours, patterns, prints and personal touches can make wonderful keepsakes.

question: Can you help with baby handprints and footprints?
answer: Yes, we’re happy to help with baby handprints and footprints. Simply book a normal Pick & Paint session and let us know when you arrive that you’d like some assistance.

question: Can complete beginners try the pottery wheel?
answer: Yes! Our wheel-throwing sessions welcome beginners, and we’ll guide you through the basics.

question: Can I book if I have used a pottery wheel before?
answer: Of course. If you have some experience, you’re welcome to come and enjoy time on the wheel. Our sessions offer beginner guidance rather than advanced lessons.

question: When will wheel-thrown pottery be ready?
answer: Wheel-thrown pottery is normally ready for collection after approximately three weeks.

question: When will hand-built clay pieces be ready?
answer: Hand-built clay pieces are normally ready for collection after approximately two weeks.

question: Can I book a birthday party or private event?
answer: Yes! We welcome birthdays, celebrations, team-building events and other group gatherings. Please contact us to discuss your preferred date and group size.

question: Can we bring our own food?
answer: Outside food is not permitted during regular shared sessions. For exclusive private bookings, you may bring your own food by prior arrangement.

question: Can we book the barn exclusively?
answer: Yes. Exclusive private bookings are available, subject to a minimum of 16 guests or a £400 minimum booking value. Contact us to discuss the options.

question: Can you accommodate larger groups?
answer: Our Pick & Paint sessions accommodate up to 30 people. Capacity varies by activity. Please contact us with your group size and preferred date.

question: Is Your Pottery Barn wheelchair accessible?
answer: Yes, our barn is wheelchair accessible. If you can let us know before your visit, we can arrange a table with more comfortable wheelchair access and easier space around the table. This helps us make your visit as relaxed and enjoyable as possible.

question: Can I bring a buggy or pram?
answer: Yes, you’re welcome to bring a buggy. Our barn is cosy and space is limited, so we’d really appreciate knowing in advance. We can then try to seat you near the entrance or at the end of a row where there’s more room.

question: Is parking available?
answer: Yes, we have on-site parking. If you’re visiting as part of a larger group, we kindly ask you to share cars where possible to help us make the best use of the available spaces.

question: When can I collect my finished pottery?
answer: Painted pottery and hand-built clay pieces are normally ready after two weeks; wheel-thrown pottery normally takes around three weeks. Please follow the collection information provided at your session.

question: What happens if I need to cancel?
answer: Our cancellation notice periods are seven days for pottery painting and 14 days for wheel throwing. Please refer to our full booking terms for details of changes, cancellations and refunds.

question: Do you offer take-home pottery painting kits?
answer: Yes! Simply visit the barn, choose your pottery and pay for your chosen pieces plus a refundable deposit for the take-home kit box. Enjoy painting at home, then return the box and your painted pottery to us. We’ll refund the box deposit when it is returned, and your pottery will be glazed, fired and normally ready for collection two weeks after you bring it back.

question: Can I buy a gift voucher?
answer: Please see our website for available gift voucher options — a lovely way to treat someone to a creative experience.

question: Where are you located?
answer: Your Pottery Barn is on Hartley Bottom Road in Hartley, Kent. Use the directions link below to find us.
